name: lysine methyltransferase 2A

function.text: KMT2A encodes a histone methyltransferase that helps establish H3K4 methylation and regulate transcriptional programs important for development and hematopoiesis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Wiedemann-Steiner syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Thymoma; Myeloid sarcoma; Acute myeloid leukemia. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
